tooltips.betterColumnsEnabled: Globally enables or disables Better Columns.
tooltips.betterColumnsAdminEnabled: Enables or disables Better Columns in all Administration lists.
tooltips.betterColumnsBottomPanelEnabled: Enables or disables Better Columns in relationship lists shown in bottom panels, such as Target Lists on a record. Disabled by default, so these lists keep the native EspoCRM columns.
tooltips.betterColumnsAllEntities: Makes enhanced column resizing and reordering available for every compatible entity.
tooltips.betterColumnsEntityList: Entities where enhanced column management is available when the all-entities option is disabled.
